Select the first 1000 IC50 activity rows with pChEMBL values for the human single-protein target CHEMBL1929 (Xanthine dehydrogenase/oxidase). Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join assays on assay_id, join target_dictionary on tid, and join compound_structures on molregno. Filter by target chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1929', target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN', tax_id = 9606, standard_type = 'IC50', standard_relation = '=', and pchembl_value not null. Return assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, and pchembl_value. Sort rows by molecule_chembl_id and assay_chembl_id. Limit to 1000 rows.
